title: Studying's postponed too
setting: A weekday evening at the family home. Yuki tries to find a day this week to take her little brother Kenji to the movies, and then both their phones bring news.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.ja: ね、ケンジ。土曜日、映画行かない？
lines.kana: ね、けんじ。どようび、えいがいかない？
lines.english: Hey, Kenji. Want to go see a movie on Saturday?

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.ja: 土曜日？…土曜日は授業ある。
lines.kana: どようび？…どようびはじゅぎょうある。

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: e, doyoubi mo jugyou aru no? jaa, nichiyoubi wa?
lines.ja: え、土曜日も授業あるの？じゃあ、日曜日は？
lines.kana: え、どようびもじゅぎょうあるの？じゃあ、にちようびは？
lines.english: What, you have class on Saturdays too? Sunday, then?

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: nichiyoubi wa benkyou. getsuyoubi, shiken aru kara.
lines.ja: 日曜日は勉強。月曜日、試験あるから。
lines.kana: にちようびはべんきょう。げつようび、しけんあるから。
lines.english: Sunday I'm studying. I've got an exam on Monday.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: shiken ka. jaa, kinyoubi wa? ...a, dame. hachiji made kaigi aru n datta.
lines.ja: 試験か。じゃあ、金曜日は？…あ、だめ。8時まで会議あるんだった。
lines.kana: しけんか。じゃあ、きんようびは？…あ、だめ。はちじまでかいぎあるんだった。
lines.english: An exam, huh. Friday, then? ...Oh, wait, that's no good. I've got a meeting till eight.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: hachiji made? shigoto isogashii ne. ...a, gakkou kara da.
lines.ja: 8時まで？仕事忙しいね。…あ、学校からだ。
lines.kana: はちじまで？しごといそがしいね。…あ、がっこうからだ。
lines.english: Till eight? Your work's busy, huh. ...Oh, a message from school.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: e, yatta! getsuyoubi no shiken, raishuu ni enki ni natta!
lines.ja: え、やった！月曜日の試験、来週に延期になった！
lines.kana: え、やった！げつようびのしけん、らいしゅうにえんきになった！
lines.english: Whoa, yes! Monday's exam got postponed to next week!

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: enki ni natta no? jaa, nichiyoubi, eiga iku?
lines.ja: 延期になったの？じゃあ、日曜日、映画行く？
lines.kana: えんきになったの？じゃあ、にちようび、えいがいく？
lines.english: It got postponed? So, movie on Sunday?

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: a, watashi ni mo kita. tanaka-san kara da.
lines.ja: あ、私にも来た。田中さんからだ。
lines.kana: あ、わたしにもきた。たなかさんからだ。
lines.english: Oh, I've got one too. It's from Tanaka-san.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: uun, kaigi ja nakute... nichiyoubi, kyuu ni shigoto haitchatta.
lines.ja: ううん、会議じゃなくて…日曜日、急に仕事入っちゃった。
lines.kana: ううん、かいぎじゃなくて…にちようび、きゅうにしごとはいっちゃった。
lines.english: No, not a meeting... Work's suddenly come up on Sunday.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: e, nichiyoubi ni shigoto haitta no? jaa, eiga wa?
lines.ja: え、日曜日に仕事入ったの？じゃあ、映画は？
lines.kana: え、にちようびにしごとはいったの？じゃあ、えいがは？
lines.english: What, work's come up on Sunday? So what about the movie?

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.kana: ごめん！らいしゅうでいい？

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: ii yo. jaa, nichiyoubi wa uchi de geemu suru.
lines.ja: いいよ。じゃあ、日曜日はうちでゲームする。
lines.kana: いいよ。じゃあ、にちようびはうちでげーむする。
lines.english: Sure. Then on Sunday I'll play games at home.

lines.speaker: yuki
lines.romaji: benkyou wa? shiken, raishuu aru n desho?
lines.ja: 勉強は？試験、来週あるんでしょ？
lines.kana: べんきょうは？しけん、らいしゅうあるんでしょ？
lines.english: What about studying? You've still got the exam next week, right?

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.romaji: shiken, enki ni natta shi. benkyou mo enki.
lines.ja: 試験、延期になったし。勉強も延期。
lines.kana: しけん、えんきになったし。べんきょうもえんき。
lines.english: Well, the exam got postponed. So studying's postponed too.

questions.english: What happens with Yuki's movie plan?

choices.english: Yuki's Friday meeting is put off, so she and Kenji go to the movie on Friday night.
Kenji's exam is postponed, so they go to the movie on Sunday, and Kenji studies on Saturday instead.
Kenji's exam is pushed back a week, which frees up Sunday, but then work comes up for Yuki, so the movie moves to next week.

questions.explanation: Lines 1-5: Yuki wants to take Kenji to a movie, but he has class on Saturday (line 2), he's studying on Sunday for Monday's exam (line 4), and she has a meeting till eight on Friday (line 5). Line 8: the exam is postponed to next week, so Sunday opens up (line 9: jaa, nichiyoubi, eiga iku?). Then Tanaka-san's message brings Sunday work for Yuki (line 13: kyuu ni shigoto haitchatta), so the movie moves to next week (line 15: raishuu de ii?), and Kenji plans games instead of studying (lines 16-18). A is wrong: Yuki's meeting never moves; the thing that gets postponed is Kenji's exam. B is wrong: they never get to Sunday's movie, because Yuki's work comes up (line 13), and Kenji's Saturday is class (line 2), not studying.

questions.english: Sora asks you, "ashita, hima? asobi ni ikanai?" (Free tomorrow? Want to go out?) You've got class tomorrow. Tell him.
questions.ja: 明日、暇？遊びに行かない？
questions.kana: あした、ひま？あそびにいかない？
questions.answer: Say you have class, with jugyou and aru (ga can drop): gomen, ashita wa jugyou aru n da.

modelAnswers.romaji: gomen, ashita wa jugyou aru n da.
modelAnswers.ja: ごめん、明日は授業あるんだ。

modelAnswers.romaji: sumimasen, ashita wa jugyou ga aru n desu.
modelAnswers.ja: すみません、明日は授業があるんです。

questions.explanation: A class on your timetable just exists: jugyou ga aru, with ga usually dropped, as in Kenji's line 2 (doyoubi wa jugyou aru) and Yuki's line 3 (e, doyoubi mo jugyou aru no?). English 'have class' tempts jugyou o motsu, but that is a teacher's teaching load, not a student going to class. n da turns it into the reason you can't go. The second model is the polite version, for someone like Satou-san.

questions.english: Yuki suggests Friday, then remembers why she can't do it. What did she say?
questions.ja: ユキさんは何と言いましたか？
questions.kana: ゆきさんはなんといいましたか？
questions.romaji: yuki-san wa nan to iimashita ka?

choices.english: Oh, that's no good. I've got a meeting till eight.
choices.romaji: a, dame. hachiji made kaigi aru n datta.

choices.english: Oh, that's no good. I'm holding a meeting till eight.
choices.romaji: a, dame. hachiji made kaigi motteru n datta.

choices.english: Oh, that's no good. Work's just come up, till eight.
choices.romaji: a, dame. hachiji made shigoto haitchatta.

questions.explanation: Line 5: a meeting on your calendar just exists, so it's kaigi ga aru (ga dropped, as usual in casual speech), and n datta adds 'oh right, I'd forgotten'. Kenji uses the same phrase in line 12 (mata kaigi aru no?). B puts English 'have' into Japanese with motsu: kaigi o motsu is at best a stiff 'hold a meeting', never a meeting you're going to. C is the scene's other kind of news: shigoto ga hairu is work that has just come up, which is what Tanaka-san's message brings in line 13. The Friday meeting was already planned; Yuki is remembering it, not reporting something new.

questions.english: Kenta asks you, "nichiyoubi, uchi ni asobi ni konai?" (Want to come over to ours on Sunday?) You've got an exam on Monday. Turn him down.
questions.ja: 日曜日、うちに遊びに来ない？
questions.kana: にちようび、うちにあそびにこない？
questions.romaji: nichiyoubi, uchi ni asobi ni konai?
questions.answer: Say you have an exam on Monday, with shiken and aru: gomen, getsuyoubi shiken aru kara.

modelAnswers.romaji: gomen, getsuyoubi shiken aru kara, benkyou suru.
modelAnswers.ja: ごめん、月曜日試験あるから、勉強する。
modelAnswers.english: Sorry, I've got an exam on Monday, so I'm studying.

modelAnswers.romaji: sumimasen, getsuyoubi ni shiken ga aru n desu.
modelAnswers.ja: すみません、月曜日に試験があるんです。
modelAnswers.english: Sorry, I have an exam on Monday.

questions.explanation: An exam on your calendar just exists: shiken ga aru, as in Kenji's line 4 (getsuyoubi, shiken aru kara) and Yuki's line 17 (shiken, raishuu aru n desho?). Not shiken o motsu. Sitting the exam is shiken o ukeru, but to turn down a plan you only need to say it's there. kara gives the reason, just as Kenji does in line 4. The second model is the polite version, for someone like Satou-san.

questions.english: Kenta asks you, "doyoubi no sakkaa, kuru yo ne?" (You're coming to football on Saturday, right?) Work has come up for you on Saturday. Tell him.
questions.ja: 土曜日のサッカー、来るよね？
questions.kana: どようびのさっかー、くるよね？
questions.romaji: doyoubi no sakkaa, kuru yo ne?
questions.answer: Say work came up, with shigoto and hairu in the past: gomen, doyoubi kyuu ni shigoto haitchatta.

modelAnswers.romaji: gomen, doyoubi kyuu ni shigoto haitchatta.
modelAnswers.ja: ごめん、土曜日急に仕事入っちゃった。
modelAnswers.english: Sorry, work's suddenly come up on Saturday.

modelAnswers.romaji: sumimasen, doyoubi wa kyuu ni shigoto ga haitchaimashita.
modelAnswers.ja: すみません、土曜日は急に仕事が入っちゃいました。
modelAnswers.english: Sorry, something's come up at work on Saturday.

questions.explanation: When work lands on a day you'd kept free, the work goes into your schedule by itself: shigoto ga hairu, with the work as the subject and no 'I' doing anything. Yuki says it in line 13 (nichiyoubi, kyuu ni shigoto haitchatta) and Kenji repeats it in line 14 (nichiyoubi ni shigoto haitta no?). -chatta adds 'sorry, it couldn't be helped'. Kaigi ga aru would only fit a meeting that was already on your calendar; Yuki makes that difference in line 13 (kaigi ja nakute...). The second model is the polite version, for someone you speak politely to.

questions.english: Kenji reads a message from school about his Monday exam. What happened to the exam?
questions.kana: げつようびのしけんは？

choices.english: It's been called off, so there won't be an exam at all.
It's been put off until next week.
Kenji has asked to sit it next week instead.

questions.explanation: Line 8: raishuu ni enki ni natta is 'got postponed to next week': the exam becomes postponed, and nobody in the sentence does the postponing. Yuki checks it in line 17 (shiken, raishuu aru n desho?), and Kenji repeats enki ni natta in line 18. A would be chuushi ni natta (called off), and Yuki's line 17 shows there is still an exam. C makes Kenji the one doing it, but he is only reading news from school (line 6: a, gakkou kara da). English 'was postponed' tempts the passive enki sareta, which sounds like an official notice; in conversation it's enki ni natta.

newWords.english: from (gakkou kara = from school); also 'because', as in shiken aru kara
